hooks.name: research-data-check
hooks.description: Check saved research data files against .kiro/steering/research-data.md

action.prompt: A research data file was saved. Check it against .kiro/steering/research-data.md: every row has type and id; references resolve (from_ref and to_ref may be "promise"); dates are YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY or unknown and carry a date kind; url, official_url and base_url contain no U+2236 or U+00B7 look-alike characters; null, empty or "unknown" URLs count as missing; news excerpts are at most 200 characters and official excerpts at most 300; case.domain uses the 12 Korean field names; only rows that pass the loading gate are present. Report each problem with its row id. Do not invent or fill in missing values.
